subject: AWS marketplace late postings and proposed retrocharge
messages:
From: Helios Cloud Billing <billing@helioscloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace — June late postings causing settlement shortfall

Hi Logan,

We were reconciling our June settlement this morning and noticed a set of late postings tied to AWS Marketplace meter ingestion that shifted into July. The net result is Helios’s June payout was short by $12,732.50 (attached: helios_june_invoice_adj.csv).

Can you confirm whether Redwood has a ledger extraction or notes that explain the late meter capture (we see a sharp spike with timestamps around 2028-06-28T23:50Z)? Our finance team is asking for an audit trail and a proposed remediation path — specifically whether Redwood will issue a retrocredit or if this will be folded into next month’s settlement.

We’ve paused payment on the disputed line pending clarification. Please let us know the quickest path to resolution; if helpful we can schedule a short call.

Thanks,
Billing Ops — Helios Cloud
billing@helioscloud.com

Attachment: helios_june_invoice_adj.csv (CSV, 12 rows)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Helios Cloud Billing <billing@helioscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:05:13 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace — June late postings causing settlement shortfall

Hi — thanks for the heads up and for the attachment. I’m looping Marissa (platform ops) and Karthik (billing engineering) so we can pull the relevant ledger and trace the ingestion window.

Quick answers up front:
- We saw a metering replay event on 2028-06-28 during a batch window cutover; that replay can cause post-period adjustments.
- We will produce a per-usage audit extract and timestamped records for the impacted SKUs.

Request: can you confirm the HubSpot company ID or the invoice IDs you’re treating as disputed? That will speed up matching on our side. Also, would Helios prefer a retrocredit applied to the next payout or an immediate wire once we agree on the amount?

I can be on a call today at 3pm PT if that works.

Best,
Logan Wright
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Helios Cloud Billing <billing@helioscloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 12:15:42 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace — June late postings causing settlement shortfall

Logan / Helios — digging in on our side. Short summary of findings so far:

- Root cause: a staging -> prod batch window cutover (2028-06-28 23:45:00 UTC) caused a delayed ingestion of meter events for a subset of AWS Marketplace SKUs tied to Helios. The metering agent replayed ~3,400 events that were timestamped in the June period but landed after our cutoff.
- Impact: $12,732.50 net short on June payout for Helios.

I’ve attached the extracted replay file (metering_replay_helios_0628.csv) and a short reconciliation worksheet. We propose two remediation options:

1) Issue a retrocredit for $12,732.50 to be applied to Helios’s August payout (fastest to implement).
2) Initiate an immediate expedited wire for the $12,732.50 once Helios signs the retrocredit agreement; payroll cutover team can schedule the wire within 48 hours after sign-off.

We recommend option 2 given you’ve paused payment on the disputed line. If Helios accepts, we’ll send a DocuSign-ready retrocredit agreement and the ledger evidence bundle.

Proposed owners: Marissa (redwood) to prepare evidence bundle and agreement; Karthik to authorize payout path; Logan to coordinate final sign-off with Helios.

Available for a call this afternoon 3–4pm PT or tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Platform Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: metering_replay_helios_0628.csv (CSV, 3400 rows)

From: Jessica Low <jessica.low@helioscloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Billing Team <billing@helioscloud.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:42:10 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace — June late postings causing settlement shortfall

Thanks for the quick investigation and the options. Helios prefers an immediate wire once the retrocredit agreement is signed — we’d rather not wait until August to reconcile this amount.

Request from our side: please include a simple audit trail (CSV with original event timestamps and the corrected ingest timestamps) and a DocuSign link for our AP manager to approve. Once the agreement is signed we’ll authorize Treasury to accept the wire and will release the paused payment lines on our side.

If you can send the DocuSign link and evidence bundle today we’ll aim to sign by EOD.

Best,
Jessica Low
Head of Finance Ops — Helios Cloud
jessica.low@helioscloud.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Low <jessica.low@helioscloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace — June late postings causing settlement shortfall

Jessica / team — thanks, agreed. Quick summary and next steps (per our discussion):

- Evidence bundle: Marissa will share the replay CSV + per-event mapping (UTC timestamp, original ingestion timestamp, corrected ingestion timestamp).
- Agreement: Redwood to send retrocredit agreement (redwood_retrocredit_agreement.pdf) via DocuSign by 19:00 PT today.
- Payment path: upon signature Redwood will trigger the expedited wire for $12,732.50; alternatively the credit can be applied to Aug payout if Helios elects not to sign.
- Deadline: please sign DocuSign by EOD Friday 21 Jul 2028 to allow a same-week wire; otherwise we will schedule the credit on August payout.

Owners: Marissa (evidence + accounting docs), Karthik (wire authorization), Logan (final sign-off + HubSpot/contract updates).

If there are any missing invoice IDs or ledger references you need included in the DocuSign package, reply-all and we’ll append.

Thanks — we’ll follow up with the DocuSign link and the full CSV bundle shortly.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Attachments pending: redwood_retrocredit_agreement.pdf, evidence_bundle.zip
